description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ProductToGLAccountMappingNotFoundException' which extends the 'AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException'. It is used to signal the absence of a product-to-GL account mapping in the application, providing context about the product type, product ID, and account type.

classes.name: ProductToGLAccountMappingNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating that a product to GL account mapping was not found, used in application error handling.

methods.name: ProductToGLAccountMappingNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with specific details about the missing mapping, including product type, ID, and account type.
